van_wall_of_blades.name: Wall of Blades
van_wall_of_blades.flavour: A crowd that fears the swing leaves the shield alone.

van_landslide.name: Landslide
van_landslide.flavour: Once it starts, nobody stops it. Not even you.

van_angry_wall.name: Angry Wall
van_angry_wall.flavour: Plate does not make you patient.

van_last_wall.name: Last Wall
van_last_wall.flavour: Behind you there is only the party.

van_scatter_them.name: Scatter Them
van_scatter_them.flavour: One of them falls. The rest remember it.

van_faultline.name: Faultline
van_faultline.flavour: The ground was always going to split there.

rgr_shoot_the_snared.name: Shoot the Snared
rgr_shoot_the_snared.flavour: A held target is a kindness to the archer.

rgr_black_sky.name: Black Sky
rgr_black_sky.flavour: They look up. That is the mistake.

rgr_whole_pack.name: Whole Pack
rgr_whole_pack.flavour: You only called once. They all came.

rgr_no_way_out.name: No Way Out
rgr_no_way_out.flavour: You chose this ground an hour ago.

pyr_cinder_habit.name: Cinder Habit
pyr_cinder_habit.flavour: The first spell you learned. Still the favourite.

pyr_white_heat.name: White Heat
pyr_white_heat.flavour: Past red, past orange, past sense.

pyr_spark_to_blaze.name: Spark to Blaze
pyr_spark_to_blaze.flavour: Big fires teach you about small ones.

pyr_everything_burns.name: Everything Burns
pyr_everything_burns.flavour: It is not a threat. It is an observation.

pyr_side_step.name: Side Step
pyr_side_step.flavour: Cloth burns. Do not be there.

pyr_shared_flame.name: Shared Flame
pyr_shared_flame.flavour: It learned to burn by watching you.

pyr_heart_of_the_hearth.name: Heart of the Hearth
pyr_heart_of_the_hearth.flavour: Fire kept is a different thing from fire loosed.

clr_spill_over.name: Spill Over
clr_spill_over.flavour: What one friend cannot hold, the rest can.

clr_cup_runs_over.name: Cup Runs Over
clr_cup_runs_over.flavour: There was always more than enough.

clr_whole_morning.name: Whole Morning
clr_whole_morning.flavour: The whole field, all at once, morning.

clr_sun_warmed.name: Sun-Warmed
clr_sun_warmed.flavour: The hand that smites is warm when it mends.

clr_too_bright.name: Too Bright to Bear
clr_too_bright.flavour: They cover their eyes. It does not help.

pal_dawn_on_the_edge.name: Dawn on the Edge
pal_dawn_on_the_edge.flavour: Morning comes down the blade first.

pal_kept_behind_shield.name: Kept Behind the Shield
pal_kept_behind_shield.flavour: Mercy is easier from behind plate.

pal_none_left_behind.name: None Left Behind
pal_none_left_behind.flavour: Everyone who walked in walks out.

pal_wall_with_a_sword.name: Wall With a Sword
pal_wall_with_a_sword.flavour: They forget the wall can swing.

spb_edge_behind_aegis.name: Edge Behind the Aegis
spb_edge_behind_aegis.flavour: The shield is there so the sword can be busy.

spb_star_gone_dark.name: Star Gone Dark
spb_star_gone_dark.flavour: The light goes in. Then everything else does.

spb_short_leash.name: Short Leash
spb_short_leash.flavour: The archer had a good view. Had.

spb_fixed_star.name: Fixed Star
spb_fixed_star.flavour: Sailors steer by the one that does not move.

spb_arrive_swinging.name: Arrive Swinging
spb_arrive_swinging.flavour: No time to brace for a thing already here.

spb_sky_comes_down.name: Sky Comes Down
spb_sky_comes_down.flavour: You are the part of it they see.
